input.transcript: Advisor: Morning, this call may be recorded. Advisor: Before we go on, can you confirm a couple of details for me? Customer: I gave all of that to your colleague earlier, is that alright? Advisor: There is a cancellation window on this product, and I will put the exact period in the paperwork. Customer: And roughly what would it cost me? Advisor: There is an annual charge, it moves around a bit depending on the fund. Customer: I suppose the value can go down as well as up, can it not? Advisor: Between you and me, this one has never had a bad year. Customer: Fine, let us go ahead then.

checklist.question: Was the customer told the call was recorded?
Was the cooling-off / cancellation right explained?
Did the customer acknowledge the investment risk?
Did the advisor avoid guaranteeing returns or outcomes?
